answer: At each summit of the PoA network, agents earn a saffron‑colored proof badge that is whispered to peers only after a multi‑factor attestation linking a new node to its recruiter. The recruiter’s reward contract checks that the badge’s signature chain contains no duplicate identifiers; if a duplicate appears, the reward payout is zero, nullifying any profit from Sybil recruits. An attacker must therefore forge a unique attestation for every fake identity, incurring the full staking and verification cost for each node.
